CustomField.label: Direction
CustomField.description: Indicates whether this external system sends data into Salesforce, reads data out of Salesforce, or does both. An Inbound-only system that writes to a field you are about to delete will error immediately; an Outbound-only system that only reads a field will not error but may silently receive incomplete or stale data going forward.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether this system sends data into Salesforce, reads data out, or both.
